fields.label: CODECO Help
fields.options:
What this template is

  • CODECO is the gate report. It is sent when a Container Reception (gate-in) or a Gate Pass (gate-out) is submitted. Unpacking is reported by the COSTCO template, not this one.

What must stay

  • The segments UNH, BGM, NAD, EQD and CNT.
  • The values {{ reference }} and {{ container_no }}.
  • Everything else may be added, moved or removed to match what this partner accepts.

Values you can use

  • {{ reference }} — The interchange reference, 14 digits. It ties UNH, BGM, UNT and UNZ together.
  • {{ message_code }} — What the movement is: 34 gate in, 36 gate out.
  • {{ message_function }} — Why this message is being sent: 9 original, 5 replaces an earlier message, 1 cancels one. It is 9 unless a correction is being sent.
  • {{ sender }} — Our code as this partner knows us. The Sender ID on this record, or the ICD Sender ID.
  • {{ shipping_line_code }} — This partner's TANeSW shipping agent code.
  • {{ icd_un_locode }} — The UN/LOCODE of this ICD.
  • {{ container_no }} — The container number.
  • {{ size }} — The ISO size type, such as 45G1.
  • {{ equipment_status }} — 3 import, 2 export.
  • {{ full_empty_indicator }} — 5 full, 4 empty.
  • {{ is_empty }} — Ask with it in a condition: {% if is_empty %}. It prints 1 when the box holds no cargo, nothing when it does not.
  • {{ is_gate_in }} — Ask with it in a condition. It prints 1 on the way in, nothing on the way out.
  • {{ m_bl_no }} — The master bill of lading number. Empty when there is none.
  • {{ event_datetime }} — When the box crossed the gate, as CCYYMMDDHHMM.
  • {{ weight }} — The gross weight in whole kilograms. Empty when it was not recorded in kilograms.
  • {{ seal_no }} — The first seal number. Empty when the box has no seal.
  • {{ transporter }} — The haulier name.
  • {{ transporter_code }} — The first two letters of the haulier name, for the code part of the inland TDT.
  • {{ truck }} — The truck registration.
  • {{ voyage_no }} — The voyage number.
  • {{ vessel_name }} — The vessel name.
  • {{ call_sign }} — The vessel call sign.

fields.label: COSTCO Help
fields.options:
What this template is

  • COSTCO is the stripping report. It is sent when a Container Unpacking is submitted: the cargo of an LCL box is counted out and the box is now empty. Gate-in and gate-out are reported by the CODECO template, not this one.
  • The gate and haulier values of CODECO, such as {{ truck }}, do not exist here.
  • The Posting Date and End Time of the unpacking are set to the moment it is submitted, and that is the stripping time this message reports.

What must stay

  • The segments UNH, BGM, TDT, NAD, EQD, CNI and CNT.
  • The values {{ reference }} and {{ container_no }}.
  • Everything else may be added, moved or removed to match what this partner accepts.

Values you can use

  • {{ reference }} — The interchange reference, 14 digits. It ties UNH, BGM, UNT and UNZ together.
  • {{ message_code }} — Always 113, the transport equipment unpacking report.
  • {{ message_function }} — Why this message is being sent: 9 original, 5 replaces an earlier message, 1 cancels one. It is 9 unless a correction is being sent.
  • {{ sender }} — Our code as this partner knows us. The Sender ID on this record, or the ICD Sender ID.
  • {{ shipping_line_code }} — This partner's TANeSW shipping agent code.
  • {{ icd_un_locode }} — The UN/LOCODE of this ICD, where the box was stripped.
  • {{ container_no }} — The container number.
  • {{ size }} — The ISO size type, such as 45G1.
  • {{ equipment_status }} — Always 3 import. Only an imported LCL box is stripped here.
  • {{ full_empty_indicator }} — Always 4 empty. The cargo has just been counted out.
  • {{ m_bl_no }} — The master bill of lading number, also the consignment of the CNI segment. Empty when there is none.
  • {{ event_datetime }} — When stripping ended, the moment the unpacking was submitted, as CCYYMMDDHHMM.
  • {{ seal_no }} — The seal number of the box before it was opened. Empty when the box had no seal.
  • {{ voyage_no }} — The voyage number.
  • {{ vessel_name }} — The vessel name.
  • {{ call_sign }} — The vessel call sign.

fields.label: Template Help
fields.options:
Every template

  • It is the body of the message, from UNH to CNT.
  • Do not write UNB, UNT or UNZ. The envelope is added for you.
  • One segment per line, each ending in an apostrophe.

How to write a value

  • Write {{ container_no }} on its own.
  • Do not write something like this {{ doc.container_no }}, {{ frappe.… }} or any other object.
  • Only the values listed for this type exist. Any other name stops the save.

What is done for you

  • Values are uppercased, cut to their maximum length and escaped, so a + or an apostrophe in a name cannot break a segment.
  • Empty elements and components at the end of a segment are dropped.
  • Leave a segment out when it has nothing to report, with {% if seal_no %}…{% endif %}.

Reset To Default

  • It replaces this template with the one shipped with the app.
  • Your changes are lost, so copy them first if you want to keep them.
